semantic_change_assertion: No physical WPT model, DES semantics, primitive grid, C1-C5 policy, epsilon feasibility rule, or rho definition is changed by this manifest.

execution_infrastructure.durable_part_file_rule: For every primitive-condition × seed CRN unit, validate exactly C1–C5 five rows and atomically write one durable part file before the worker exits.
execution_infrastructure.resume_rule: Existing valid part files are skipped. Invalid or partial files cause a hard failure; they are never silently overwritten.
execution_infrastructure.solver_record_rule: Do not retain solver records beyond one CRN unit; worker process exits after the unit.

required_validation: single-worker C1-C5 full-unit smoke/stress using smoke seeds only
record per-child peak RSS and confirm child exit/release
two-worker C5 stress test using smoke seeds only
raise official concurrency to 2 only if a sufficient margin is observed
resource_gate.selection_rule: Use two official workers only if two-worker peak aggregate RSS remains at or below 70% of the 4-GiB cgroup limit and all isolated children exit. Otherwise use one C5 worker and at most two C1-C4 workers.
